name: Virgin Gorda Airport
before:
A small airport on Virgin Gorda in the British Virgin Islands.

Treat scheduled service here as something to verify rather than assume. The airport has a long history of commuter airlines flying in from San Juan and the US Virgin Islands, including American Eagle, Sunaire as Eastern Express, Crown Air, Virgin Island Airways, Vieques Air Link and the Tortola-based Air BVI, but all of those are past operations. Check current schedules directly before quoting a client.

The aircraft that served it tell you the scale: Twin Otters, Britten-Norman Islanders, Cessna 402s, all short take-off types.

Tortola is very close. Air BVI once ran a no-reservation shuttle between Beef Island on Tortola and Virgin Gorda with a flight time of five minutes.
after:
The airport on Virgin Gorda in the British Virgin Islands, also called Taddy Bay Airport. Its runway is short and unpaved.

Tradewind Aviation offers scheduled flights from San Juan, and charter flights come in from around the region. Check current schedules before quoting a client.

claims.note: Replaces the list of past airlines. The tourist board gives the season as 10 December 2026 to 12 April 2027 and also names Cape Air (from San Juan and St Thomas) and Seaborne (from St Thomas); Wikipedia and the airports authority's page, which copies Wikipedia word for word, say Air Sunshine is the only scheduled airline. With the sources split, only Tradewind, which confirms its own service, is named.
